stimulus.alt: Decision diagram separating routine operator checks and accessible cleaning from protected access, disassembly, jam clearing, electrical work, and other servicing that may require authorized maintenance or hazardous-energy controls.
stimulus.caption: Use the boundary diagram to distinguish a readiness failure from a condition the Technician I role is authorized to repair.

stem: During a pre-use check, a powered processing device is missing a required guard. What is the best response?
choices: Remove it from service through the site process and escalate the missing safeguard
Use it carefully until maintenance arrives
Operate it only at half speed
Have another worker stand nearby as a spotter
rationale: Required machine safeguards are not optional production obstacles. A failed readiness condition should change equipment status and trigger escalation.
